units.contents:
[Unit]
Description=DCIM-managed kubeadm init (first control-plane)
After=network-online.target containerd.service
Wants=network-online.target containerd.service
ConditionPathExists=!/etc/kubernetes/admin.conf

[Service]
Type=oneshot
RemainAfterExit=yes
EnvironmentFile=/etc/dcim/cluster.env
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/kubeadm init --pod-network-cidr=${POD_CIDR_V6} --service-cidr=${SVC_CIDR_V6} --control-plane-endpoint=${CONTROL_PLANE_EP} --skip-phases=addon/kube-proxy

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
units.name: kubeadm-init.service
